plan: Land at Krabi airport, drive 20 minutes to Rayavadee’s pier and take the 20-minute resort speedboat to Railay. Easy first evening walk along Railay West beach, with no swim.
romantic: Sunset on Railay West beach, then a quiet first dinner at the resort.

plan: The one boat day: a private Rayavadee speedboat to the Hong Islands, leaving early to beat the crowds. Kayak into the Hong lagoon when the tide allows, climb the 419-step viewpoint, then swim from Hong Island’s sandy beach.
romantic: A picnic lunch for two on Hong Island’s beach, with the boat to yourselves.

plan: White-water rafting on the Song Phraek river in Phang Nga: resort boat to the mainland, then about 1.5 hours by road. Run the 5 km course of Class II-III rapids, with an optional 30-minute ATV ride at the camp.
romantic: Couples massage at Rayavadee Spa back at the resort.

plan: A slow day on Railay. Rayavadee’s Monday Thai cooking class (11:30-14:00) covers spring rolls, tom yum goong and red curry, then a free afternoon at the villa.
romantic: Candlelit dinner at The Grotto, set under the cliff on Phra Nang beach.

plan: Private half-day beginner rock-climbing class on Railay’s limestone walls, starting early before the heat. Afternoon swim at Phra Nang Cave Beach, a short walk from the villa.
romantic: A private dinner on the sand under the stars, set up by the resort.

plan: Morning flight to Bangkok (about 1 hour 20 minutes) and check in at The Peninsula. Late-afternoon go-karting at Topkart Bangkok near Chidlom.
romantic: Watch the city lights come on from the glass floor of Mahanakhon SkyWalk.

plan: Grand Palace and the Emerald Buddha at the 8:30 opening, then the Reclining Buddha at Wat Pho, a short walk away. Rest in the afternoon, then end the year on the riverfront beside ICONSIAM, Bangkok’s main countdown spot.
romantic: New Year’s Eve gala on The Peninsula’s riverside lawn, facing the ICONSIAM fireworks at midnight.

plan: Slow New Year’s morning. Afternoon at ICONSIAM next door and its SookSiam indoor market, then an evening street-food walk on Yaowarat in Chinatown.
romantic: A tuk-tuk ride together under the neon signs of Yaowarat Road to close the trip.

plan: Land in Ho Chi Minh City and take a private car to Mui Ne on the expressway (about three to four hours). Check in at the Anantara and take an easy walk on the resort beach.
romantic: Christmas dinner at a private Dining by Design table on the resort’s sand.

plan: Sunrise jeep tour to the White Sand Dunes with a quad-bike ride, then the fishing village and the ankle-deep Fairy Stream walk. Rest at the resort in the afternoon.
romantic: Sandboard down the Red Sand Dunes, then watch the sunset together from the top.

plan: Morning at the Po Sah Inu Cham Towers, then the resort’s Spice Spoons cooking class with a local market visit. Optional swim in front of the resort if the sea is calm.
romantic: Couples massage at the Anantara Spa.

plan: Drive back to Ho Chi Minh City (about three to four hours) and rest at the Park Hyatt. In the evening, the XO Foodie Tour by motorbike picks you up at the hotel.
romantic: Nightcap at the Saigon Saigon Rooftop Bar at the Caravelle, across the square from the hotel.

plan: Morning at the Independence Palace and the War Remnants Museum. In the afternoon, race go-karts at TGC Speedway in The Global City (about 25 minutes away), with a two-seat kart option.
romantic: Riverside dinner on the wooden deck of The Deck Saigon in Thao Dien, ten minutes from the track.

plan: Photo stop at the pink Tan Dinh Church, then the view from Landmark 81 SkyView, the tallest building in Vietnam. Slow afternoon at the hotel.
romantic: Saigon Princess dinner cruise on the Saigon River.

plan: Slow morning to rest for the late night. AO Show bamboo circus at the Saigon Opera House at 18:00, then an early dinner nearby.
romantic: Countdown on Nguyen Hue Walking Street, with midnight fireworks over the street and the river.

plan: New Year’s Day shopping at Saigon Centre and Takashimaya, then the Central Post Office and the Dong Khoi boutiques.
romantic: Coffee together in a book café on Nguyen Van Binh Book Street, beside the Post Office.

plan: Land in Kuala Lumpur and take the 1-hour flight to Langkawi. The Ritz-Carlton is about 10 minutes from the airport, so settle in and walk the resort’s private beach, with no swim planned.
romantic: Late Christmas dinner on the overwater decks of Hai Yan, the resort’s Chinese restaurant.

plan: SkyCab cable car and the Sky Bridge at the 9:30 opening, 10 minutes from the hotel, using the SkyGlide lift instead of the forest trail. Late-afternoon go-karting on the 1.3 km track at Morac Adventure Park near the airport, about 15 minutes away.
romantic: Watch the evening fire show from beanbags at Kalut Cafe and Bar on Pantai Cenang, a few minutes from the track.

plan: Paint your own batik piece at Atma Alam Batik Art Village in Padang Matsirat, about 15 minutes away. At 5 pm board the Tropical Charters sunset cruise from the Resorts World Langkawi marina, and skip the net swim.
romantic: Barbecue dinner on deck as the sun sets over the Andaman Sea.

plan: A slow day at the resort. Morning swim at the Ritz-Carlton’s private sandy beach, the only swim day of the trip, when the beach staff say it is safe.
romantic: Couples treatment in one of the resort spa’s overwater pavilions.

plan: Fly to Kuala Lumpur, about 1 hour. Free traditional dance show at the Malaysia Tourism Centre (MaTiC) on Jalan Ampang at 3 pm, then dinner at the Jalan Alor food street.
romantic: Sunset drinks at Marini’s on 57, the rooftop bar facing the Petronas Towers.

plan: Full-day white-water rafting on the Selangor River at Kuala Kubu Bharu, about 1 hour away, with hotel pickup and lunch. The rapids are grade 2 to 4, and a guide steers each raft.
romantic: Evening walk in KLCC Park to watch the Lake Symphony fountain show at 8, 9 or 10 pm.

plan: LaZat Malaysian cooking class with a wet-market tour in Taman Tun Dr Ismail, from 8:30 to about 13:30, roughly 25 minutes away. Rest at the hotel in the afternoon.
romantic: New Year’s Eve countdown and fireworks over the Petronas Towers at the KLCC Park Esplanade, a short walk from the hotel.

plan: Late start. Merdeka Square and the newly reopened Sultan Abdul Samad Building gallery, 15 minutes by car, then Aquaria KLCC, a short walk from the hotel.
romantic: Afternoon tea with live piano in the Four Seasons Lounge, served 3 to 5:30 pm.

plan: Fly Manila to Busuanga, landing by early afternoon, then take the resort van and boat to Two Seasons Coron Island. Easy first evening on the resort beach.
romantic: Christmas dinner on the resort’s beach.

plan: A slow day at the resort with no boat trips. Swim from the white-sand beach, walk out to the sandbar and laze by the big pool.
romantic: Couples massage at the resort spa.

plan: Morning resort boat to Coron town and an early climb up Mount Tapyas (about 720 steps) for the view over Coron Bay. Then the public market and a paluto lunch, where you pick seafood at the market and have it cooked nearby. Back on the afternoon resort boat.
romantic: Take in the view over Coron Bay together from the cross at the top of Mount Tapyas.

plan: Resort boat and van to Busuanga airport, then the 40-minute AirSWIFT flight to El Nido, which lands about 5 minutes from Seda Lio. Easy afternoon walk on Lio Beach.
romantic: An evening stroll through Kalye Artisano in the Lio estate to pick a handmade keepsake for each other.

plan: Your one boat day: a private Tour A boat to kayak the Big Lagoon and Small Lagoon, then a beach stop at Seven Commandos. Skip the snorkel stops.
romantic: Lunch served on your private boat in a quiet cove.

plan: Morning Filipino cooking class in El Nido (adobo and kinilaw). In the late afternoon, zipline from the hill above Las Cabanas Beach to Depeldet Island, then stay for sunset.
romantic: Stargazing on Lio Beach before the late moonrise.

plan: Morning Taraw Cliff via ferrata: a harnessed climb with a rope bridge and views over Bacuit Bay. Rest at Seda Lio, then spend New Year’s Eve in El Nido town.
romantic: Countdown on a rooftop above El Nido town, with fireworks over Bacuit Bay.

plan: Ride a scooter (or take a private tricycle) north from Lio to Nacpan Beach for a swim and lunch at a beach shack. Expect holiday opening hours today.
romantic: Toast the new year with fresh coconuts in a hammock at Nacpan.

plan: Land at Velana airport and take the Kaani speedboat to Maafushi, about 35 minutes. Rest, then take a short walk through the village lanes and harbour in modest clothes.
romantic: Watch the sunset from Bikini Beach after the long journey.

plan: A beach morning at Bikini Beach, the sandy, shallow swimming area about 40 metres from the hotel. Lunch at a beach café and a slow afternoon.
romantic: Stargazing on the beach after dark, with insect repellent on.

plan: Water sports from the beach with no swimming: a tandem parasail ride plus a jet ski or jet car session with Maafushi Dive. Rest in the afternoon.
romantic: Fly side by side on the tandem parasail.

plan: A slow morning with souvenir shopping in the village. In the late afternoon, the trip’s only boat outing: a dolphin-watching cruise, watching only, no swimming.
romantic: Spot dolphins together from the bow of the boat.

plan: Morning speedboat to the airport and a half-day in Malé: the Old Friday Mosque, Sultan Park, the National Museum and the fish market, with Maldivian short eats for lunch. Afternoon speedboat to Niva Velassaru, 25 minutes.
romantic: Champagne and oysters on the resort beach, a free festive event from 5 to 6 pm.

plan: A wellness day: a couples ritual at the LIME overwater spa, then the Japanese brunch at Sora, the overwater restaurant.
romantic: Cinema Under the Stars, a free outdoor film night at Fen.

plan: A free tennis session in the morning and a quiet afternoon. In the evening, the New Year’s Eve dinner, then the Pure Celestial party on the main beach.
romantic: Count down to midnight barefoot on the sand at the beach party.

plan: Late breakfast, then adopt a coral frame with your names on it through the resort’s marine team. Optional last swim from the sandy main beach before flying home the next day.
romantic: Private candlelit dinner for two in a beach cabana.
